SET	@prov_c := '%s';
SET @id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d1:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d1:=concat(@b_year-1,'1231');
SET	@start_d2:=concat(@b_year,'0101');
SET @end_d2:=concat(@b_year,'0331');
SET	@start_d3:=concat(@b_year,'0401');
SET @end_d3:=concat(@b_year,'0630');
SET	@start_d4:=concat(@b_year,'0701');
SET @end_d4:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmpz_diag1;
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmpz_diag2;

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmpz_diag1 (
INDEX(HOSPCODE,CID,DATE_SERV,lastfcg)
) ENGINE=MyISAM  AS 
(
SELECT d.HOSPCODE,d.CID,d.DATE_SERV ,l.LABRESULT lastfcg,lab_date
FROM tmp_diag_opd d 
	INNER JOIN 
	(SELECT cid,DATE_SERV lab_date,LABRESULT 
	FROM
	(SELECT cid,DATE_SERV,LABRESULT 
	FROM tmp_labfu 
	WHERE labtest in('0531002','0531101') AND DATE_SERV<=@end_d1
	ORDER BY DATE_SERV DESC ) 
	l1
	GROUP BY cid	
	) l ON l.cid=d.CID AND d.DATE_SERV>=l.lab_date
	
WHERE d.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d1 AND @end_d1  
	AND (substr(d.DIAGCODE,1,3) BETWEEN  'E10' AND 'E14')
						
GROUP BY d.HOSPCODE,d.CID,d.DATE_SERV 
ORDER BY concat(d.HOSPCODE, d.cid) ASC ,DATE_SERV DESC
) ;


CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmpz_tr1 (
INDEX(HOSPCODE)
) ENGINE=MyISAM  AS 
(
SELECT
 tb01.hospcode,COUNT(tb01.cid) b1,SUM(if(tb01.control=1,1,0)) a1
FROM
(SELECT
d.hospcode,d.cid,if(lastfcg BETWEEN 70 AND 130,1,0) control
FROM
tmpz_diag1 d
GROUP BY
d.hospcode,d.cid
) tb01
GROUP BY tb01.hospcode
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_kpi_dm_ctrl_pcu(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  target1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  result1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  target2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  result2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  target3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  target4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_kpi_dm_ctrl_pcu WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_kpi_dm_ctrl_pcu 
(
SELECT @id,tb1.HOSPCODE,tb1.areacode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
			,(b1+b2+b3+b4) b,(a1+a2+a3+a4) a,b1,a1,b2,a2,b3,a3,b4,a4
FROM
(SELECT 
	h.hoscode hospcode,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
	,IFNULL(t1.b1,0) b1,IFNULL(t1.a1,0) a1,IFNULL(t2.b2,0) b2,IFNULL(t2.a2,0) a2,IFNULL(t3.b3,0) b3,IFNULL(t3.a3,0) a3,IFNULL(t4.b4,0) b4,IFNULL(t4.a4,0) a4
FROM
chospital h
	LEFT JOIN tmpz_tr1  t1 ON t1.hospcode=h.hoscode
	LEFT JOIN tmpz_tr2  t2 ON t2.hospcode=h.hoscode
	LEFT JOIN tmpz_tr3  t3 ON t3.hospcode=h.hoscode
	LEFT JOIN tmpz_tr4  t4 ON t4.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c) AND h.hostype not in(1,2,5,6,7,11,12,15,17,19)
	AND (t1.b1 is not NULL or t2.b2 is not NULL or t3.b3 is not NULL or t4.b4 is not NULL)
GROUP BY h.hoscode
) tb1
)
;

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as areacode, ar_name as a_name, SUM(target) as target, SUM(result) as result, SUM(target1) as targetq1, SUM(result1) as resultq1, SUM(target2) as targetq2, SUM(result2) as resultq2, SUM(target3) as targetq3, SUM(result3) as resultq3, SUM(target4) as targetq4, SUM(result4) as resultq4 FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT changwatcode as ar_code, changwatname as ar_name, changwatcode as l_code FROM cchangwat WHERE ( zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) ORDER BY l_code ) as ar ON left(s.areacode, 2) = ar.l_code LEFT JOIN chospital_regis as h ON s.hospcode = h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN ('5', '6', '7', '11', '12', '15') AND h.hdc_regist = 1 AND h.status = '1' AND ( zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) INNER JOIN ccmihosp sp ON sp.hcode = h.hoscode AND sp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE s.id = {{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT(s.areacode, 2) not IN ('99') AND b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( h.provcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( sp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.dep in ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.mcode = {{MINISTRY_CODE}} or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( h.hoscode = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} GROUP BY h.hoscode, ar_name ORDER BY h.hoscode
